title: Minimal surfaces — Question 4.1
exact_target: Characterize all metrics for which a given taut foliation can be isotoped so that every leaf is minimal.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300007 (AMR-102-0007). CC BY 4.0.
